title: A software thing I built: GPS on a 25MHz 486-SX
summary: A retro computing hobbyist built a functional GPS navigation application running on a vintage 25MHz 486-SX processor from the early 1990s, demonstrating that legacy hardware can still handle modern tasks with creative software solutions.
problem_solved: Shows that 30-year-old computer hardware can be repurposed for practical modern applications like GPS navigation with proper low-level optimization.
why_valuable: Preserves retro computing knowledge and demonstrates impressive low-level programming skills while breathing new life into vintage hardware that would otherwise be discarded.
